title: Sound 1

components.label: a)
components.name: Sound 1 - Basics of sound and music design

learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: outline basic principles and techniques for the design of sound and music for games and immersive media.
understand basic principles and techniques of interactive and immersive sound and music.
apply the learned concepts and techniques in the design of sound and music.
identify essential concepts and techniques in the design of sound and music.
create sound and music for games and immersive media in first design studies.
critically discuss the quality of design and production of sound and music in games and immersive media.

individual_component_content.component: a) Sound 1 - Basics of sound and music design
items: Basics of sound, listening and sonic interaction
Impact of sound and music in media environments
Basics of digital audio (in sound and music processing)
Basic concepts, techniques and tools in interactive and immersive audio design
Basics of sound design for interactive and immersive media
Design principles and challenges for music in interactive and immersive media
Music genres and aesthetics (in games and immersive media)
Music and emotion (in games and immersive media)
